perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

enhanced.name: Proximity Grenades

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

enhanced.name: Rimestealer
enhanced.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Lead from Gold
enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.description: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

enhanced.name: Air Trigger
enhanced.description: Greatly increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are further increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

enhanced.name: Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
enhanced.description: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

enhanced.name: Redirection
enhanced.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

enhanced.name: Reaper's Tithe
enhanced.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Improved timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.
